cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/positions && mv pos.py.new pos.py && chown tbot:tbot pos.py && chown -R tbot:tbot __pycache__ && echo  | base64 -d > patch_claude_tab3.py && python3 patch_claude_tab3.py /opt/trading-bot/classic && cd /opt/trading-bot/classic && /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile classic_pos_html.py && echo html-ok && cat > /etc/systemd/system/chan-orders.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Claude paper limit orders (chan_orders)
After=network.target
[Service]
User=tbot
ExecStart=/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /opt/trading-bot/positions/chan_orders.py loop

Restart=always
Nice=10
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
